summary.oneLiner: An integrated leather-footwear platform with over four decades of expertise, anchored in in-house design, manufacturing, and responsible leather processing, now sharpening focus on distinct consumer brands for domestic and international markets.
summary.business: Mirza International is an integrated footwear company that designs, manufactures, and sells leather footwear and accessories. It operates through in-house design studios, tanneries, and manufacturing facilities, serving both domestic and international markets. The company is strengthening its brand portfolio—Thomas Crick, Off the Hook, and Oaktrak—each targeting distinct consumer segments with a focus on quality, comfort, finish, and accessible pricing.
